desc: The circular platform's perimeter is constructed from harsh, blocky staircase steps that cut jaggedly into the smooth ground terrain.
The perimeter of the circular paved area has jagged, stair-stepped grid geometry that does not blend cleanly with the surrounding terrain.
The pedestal is flatly and brightly overexposed compared to the ambient lighting and nearby lamp post.
The circular stone platform has jagged, stair-stepped rectangular edges that look like incomplete or broken mesh geometry.
The paved walkway ends abruptly in sharp floating edges, making it unclear whether the path continues or is blocked.
The concrete walkway slab cuts off awkwardly near the monument, creating an unnatural seam and offset in the path geometry.
The walkway consists of dark angular planes that merge visually into dark ground shadows, making walkable elevation changes and paths ambiguous.
The grey path slab clips sharply into the dirt terrain without any edge transition or border geometry.
Harsh foliage shadows and low-contrast dark gray slabs obscure the edges and directions of the walkable path.
Small light-green spheres are uniformly scattered along the left path edge, appearing as stray or visually confusing asset clutter.
The dark ground slabs cut into the terrain with low lighting contrast, making it difficult to discern navigable paths from non-traversable ground.
Small, identical green spheres are scattered along the left ground plane without clear contextual function or proper terrain blending.
